references.text: Hazar-Shual is also mentioned here as one of the cities allotted to the tribe of Simeon, showing the overlap between the inheritance areas of Judah and Simeon
Describes the southern border of the land of Canaan, which includes the area where these cities were located in the Negev region
Beth-pelet is mentioned as one of the cities where the descendants of Simeon lived, showing continuity in settlement from the time of Joshua
Beth-pelet is mentioned as one of the cities that was repopulated after the exile, showing that these cities were still known in later times
